acceptance_rule: Focused tests prove fail-closed validation and deterministic projection into the existing HypothesisCandidate contract; baseline strategy artifact remains byte-identical; no production or trading path imports the adapter.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Alpha-enabling governance hypothesis: a fail-closed Investment Team research card requiring four explicit role findings, separated researchability grading, financial cross-source evidence, and an existing HypothesisCandidate projection will prevent unsupported narrative leads from entering D0-D3 without changing strategy logic, orders, ranking, sizing, or Gate thresholds.

in_flight_duplicate_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §7 并发重复 reserve: the novelty gate cannot see in-flight tickets, so reservation re-checks open proposed/claimed/running tickets from the last 7 days and blocks fingerprint near-duplicates (score >= 0.65). Coordinate via scripts/list_experiments.py and scripts/agent_mailbox.py instead of racing.

nearest.reopen_condition: A valid retry needs a shared helper plus daily default-off snapshot with fresh forward rows, PIT SIC-as-of-filing repair, or a materially new entity relation/economic data source.

A valid retry needs materially richer PIT semantic provenance, such as extracted numeric guidance deltas versus prior guidance, segment revenue deltas, analyst breadth/dispersion, or closed forward replacement-value rows from a shared daily helper.

A legal retry needs prospective closed forward replacement rows, normalized executive-role extraction from primary documents, independent management-change data, or another non-SEC source that identifies leadership quality.

Best next alpha work is data-edge construction, not another replay: historical PIT 13F/crowding snapshots by filing availability date, supplier/customer concentration or payment-term contract fields for DPO, borrow fee/availability/utilization, PIT options history with vendor_asof, or mature closed forward replacement-value rows from accepted shared helpers.

A valid retry needs materially richer PIT semantic provenance, such as extracted backlog growth rate, book-to-bill magnitude, contract duration/funding certainty, named customer importance, or forward replacement-value rows from a shared daily helper.

observed_only_streak_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 forward-row attribution: after 3 consecutive observed-only closes on one data_source population, a further observed-only probe needs materially more settled rows, a new data source, or a new gate shape.

recipe_lane_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 排名/枚举清单消费: consuming a ranked list or finite taxonomy with one fixed evaluation recipe, one item per ID, is loop unrolling — not new evidence. After the lane triggers, only a single pooled batch (once) or park is legal. Curated lanes: docs/recipe_lanes.jsonl.

reopen_condition_guard.rule: If a parked surface has a quantitative reopen_condition, alpha-lane reservations that target that surface are blocked until the numeric reopen checks pass, unless the ticket names a genuinely new data source or a new gate shape.

routine_materialization_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 routine delta materialization: after 3 routine forward-ledger materialization IDs (one concrete surface, or same-shape across surfaces within 7 days), wire the materialization into run.py / the settlement pipeline once instead of reserving further manual IDs. Fault recovery is exempt.

saturated_source_axis.rule: For saturated (gate_shape, data_source) cells, legal override axes are limited to a new data source, a new gate shape, or materially more closed/settled forward rows. Same-source new fields/tags do not qualify.

prediction.confidence_reason: The adapter is isolated in new files and delegates machine-candidate validation to the existing contract.
